name: Sony BRAVIA 4K UR3
summary: Sony BRAVIA 4K UR3 ships with tracking, ads, recommendations and shop demo mode. TidyTV is a free phone app with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This Sony BRAVIA UR3 runs Android TV 10. It ships with tracking, ads and recommendation rows, a demo and shop mode, a voice assistant and a few preloaded apps that most owners never open. The list has 17 apps in total, grouped by what they do.

All of them stayed off after a restart on a real set. Chromecast stayed, and Sony's HDMI, tuner, Bravia Sync and remote services are left alone. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything. It had not been lived with for weeks yet.
keep: HDMI, the tuner, Bravia Sync and the remote
Firmware update services (if you want updates)
Apple TV app, used as a dock app here
notes: The voice assistant entries are optional. Skip them to keep the mic button.
If the home screen fails, the TV falls back to the Settings home screen, so you do not land on a black screen.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my Sony UR3?
faq.a: Not with the default list, which switches off the voice assistant. Leave those three apps on to keep the mic button.
Yes. AirPlay and HomeKit are kept.

faq.q: Does it have a way back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything in the app turns every app back on in one tap, and puts the old home screen back if you changed it.
